registration_id.description: Restrict the answer to prices scoped to this registered model.

provider_model_id.description: Restrict the answer to this provider-side model identifier.

include_stale.description: When true (the default) a cached price whose provenance is marked stale is still returned, so a failed refresh leaves the last good value visible. When false, stale records are omitted and the caller sees fewer records rather than an old price.

description: Read cached prices. This is a read path: it never performs a network fetch, so an empty or stale answer is resolved by running prices.refresh, not by retrying this call.
